# Kumma Wu: fuller context

> Kumma Wu, Los Angeles. In the gym most days. Trades options. Builds software. Reads old texts slowly — the Diamond Sutra, the Daodejing, Zhuangzi, the Gospels, the Greeks — and draws: bamboo, geometry, negative space.

## What the site is
kumma.me is a personal site, the front face of @Comma_9fie on X. Its language is paper, ink and one red ballpoint line: every mark on it is drawn live, in order, in one take. It is not a résumé.

## The questions underneath
- Agency (主体性): acting from oneself rather than being acted on.
- Acting under uncertainty: judge the decision, not the outcome.
- Cognition becoming embodied judgment: understanding that turns into how you move.
- Leverage: capital, software, knowledge and creative work as ways for effort to compound.

## Practice
- Trade: options, as a craft, not a casino. (No returns, positions or methods are published.)
- Build: software as leverage. See https://kumma.me/work/
  - KOTA: a voice agent that turns restaurant phone calls into menu-verified kitchen tickets in real time. https://kumma.me/work/kota/ — live product https://kota.kummalabs.com
  - ARCHON: an open-source, self-hostable agent that works as a control plane: it routes across Claude, GPT and Gemini, delegates to coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) and keeps its work inspectable. https://kumma.me/work/archon/ — repo https://github.com/Comma0101/archon
  - Audiobook AI: any document read as one continuous audiobook. https://kumma.me/work/audiobook/
  - Trade ledger: a brokerage export turned into a correct per-trade record. https://kumma.me/work/robinhood-dashboard/
  - Voice agent demo: https://kumma.me/call/ · Stress suite for voice agents: https://kumma.me/benchmark/
- Study: essays at https://kumma.me/notes/ — On Emotions; We’re All Walking Toward the Same Light; The outsider’s truth (on Camus’s The Stranger).
- Draw: https://kumma.me/studies/
